docs.title: Welcome, I am
docs.text:
A software engineer and data scientist by training, I have broad interests across computer science and data science, and I am particularly enthusiastic about questions that span traditionally quantitative and qualitative disciplines. Topics of interest include:

1) software architecture and design;

2) machine learning and deep learning;

3) health literacy and clear communication in medicine and public health;

Many aspects of my research program involve natural language processing and analysis of multimodal information. Across all projects, I aim to promote clear communication through attention to visualization.

  • Email: mc36401@.um.edu.mo
